the two subdomains disagree at the interface: max relative field jump 9.305e-01, max relative FLUX jump 1.946e+00. the jump does not shrink under refinement (field [9.305e-01, 8.411e-01, 5.996e-01], flux [1.756e+00, 1.777e+00, 1.946e+00]). A jump that stays O(1) under refinement means the scheme converged to a fixed point of the wrong transmission condition — which the observed order cannot see, because convergence to a wrong answer is still convergence.
